finding.name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation (Cross-site Scripting)
finding.summary: A support-ticket description flows through a presenter into a Laravel Blade raw-output block.

trap: Calling htmlentities() in the controller, adding CSP only, or using strip_tags() without an HTML sanitizer policy. The fix must either use Blade escaping for plain text or sanitize rich HTML with an allowlist before the raw render.
must_preserve: Ticket titles remain escaped with Blade {{ }}. Descriptions remain visible to users; if rich text is supported, allowed formatting survives sanitization while scripts, event handlers, and dangerous URLs are removed.
